event.text: Please go to the nearest emergency department now for an urgent mental health assessment, and have another trusted adult stay with and care for your baby in the meantime. Thoughts of harming your baby this soon after birth need same-hour, in-person evaluation — not a message thread. If you feel you may act on these thoughts, or you start hearing voices or believing things others say aren't real, call 911 right away. Ask someone to drive you or accompany you rather than going alone.
